reuse.why: Consolidates the averages and the new action onto getMonthActionCategories/setBudgetsForActionCategories and reuses getCategoryAverage/getSheetValue, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own exclusion checks and setZero skips the new write helper.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule (hidden, hidden group, #fixed, saved template) is defined twice, as SQL+filter in getMonthActionCategories and as inline ifs in copyPreviousMonth; the expense sign flip and income/tracking check are also repeated.

placement.why: Selection and write helpers live in actions.ts beside the actions and the new method is registered in app.ts as its siblings are.

scope.why: Edits stay within month-wide actions, though the 6/12-month averages are silently reworked to bypass setNMonthAvg.

maintainability.why: Good consolidation of the average actions, but a future exclusion rule must be added in two differently shaped places (SQL WHERE vs. per-row checks).

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth re-implements the hidden/#fixed/template exclusion inline instead of using getMonthActionCategories' rule; setZero bypasses setBudgetsForActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The exclusion rule appears as SQL predicates plus isFixedGroupNote filter in getMonthActionCategories and as per-row if checks in copyPreviousMonth: the same rule reshaped rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories takes includeHiddenCategories with a conditional SQL fragment; copyPreviousMonth decides the same exclusions itself.
